To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we successfully synthesized Li4Ti5 O12 anode materials with high surface area and high-rate performance using a facile synthetic route.
Li4Ti5 O12 powders with a nanometer size were successfully synthesized by two different synthetic processes.

the Li4Ti5 O12 anodes prepared by the urea-forces hydrolysis/ precipitation route exhibit excellent electrochemical performance, especially at high charge-discharge rates, and that the Li4T i5O12 anode prepared in the ethanol medium has a higher specific capacity, which is attributed to a larger specific surface area.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a facile synthesis of Li4 Ti5O 12 with a large surface area and its electrochemical performance as a high-power anode material for Li-ion batteries.
the synthesis of Li-ion battery anode materials with high rate capability and long cycle life, which are essential for high power and high energy density batteries for electric vehicle applications.
the development of a new synthetic process for Li4Ti5 O12, which is a promising anode material for high-power Li-ion batteries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Li4Ti5o12 prepared from anatase Ti02 in an ethanol solution has a better electrochemical performance than that prepared from anatases in a water solution, and that the electrochemical performance of Li4Ti50o12 can be improved significantly by increasing the specific surface area of the anatase precursor.
the use of a urea-forced precipitation route to prepare Li4 Ti5O 12 from TiO2 precursors is a facile, low-temperature synthetic route.
the Li4Ti5 O12 synthesized in water media has a better electrochemical performance than that synthesized in ethanol media.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the synthesis of Li-ion battery anode materials using TiO2 nanoparticle precursors is a very promising approach.

Li4Ti5 O12 anodes with a high surface area and a nanosized morphology could exhibit a high-rate capacity of 120 mAh g-1 at a high current density of 20 C and a stable capacity retention of 90% after 100 cycles at a high current of 5 C.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Li4Ti5 O12 anodes synthesized in ethanol medium showed better electrochemical performance than those synthesized in aqueous solution.
the LiOH-mediated synthetic route in water is a simple and effective way to produce Li4Ti5 O12 powders with excellent electrochemical performance.
the use of anatase Ti4O2 nanoprecursor and the addition of a small amount of Li2CO3 in an ethanol medium are the key factors to produce nano-Li4Ti5O121 with excellent electrochemical properties.
